summary: A steel lookout in Indiana's Pike State Forest, built around 1935 (sources differ on dates), marked closed on a 2022 state forest map.

facts.design: Four-leg steel tower with a cabin at the top

access.note: Marked closed on the June 2022 Pike State Forest map legend, per Indiana Fire Towers

events.note: Completed in 1935 per the Indiana Fire Towers history page; its Hartwell page gives a 1935 to 1952 build window
NGS datasheet places a tower at the current site by 1946
Marked closed on the June 2022 Pike State Forest map legend

evidence.supports: Pike State Forest location; overlooks the Patoka River valley
evidence.quote: Located in Pike State Forest, this tower overlooks the Patoka River valley.
THE TOWER IS OF FOUR LEG STEEL
CONSTRUCTION WITH A CABIN AT THE TOP.
IT IS SILVER IN COLOR AND IS ABOUT 100 FEET HIGH.
DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1946 (WJC)

evidence.supports: 1935 to 1952 window; replaced an earlier tower south of Highway 64
evidence.quote: built between 1935 and 1952 and replaced a previous tower which was located south of Highway 64.
Hartwell tower in Pike State Forest was completed in 1935.
Constructed prior to 1952 to serve as a lookout for forest fires

evidence.supports: tower at current site by 1946 per NGS datasheet
evidence.quote: Tower existed in 1946 at the current site according to the NGS datasheet for JA1972.

evidence.supports: 1936 map shows earlier fire tower off old I-64 southwest of Augusta
evidence.quote: The 1936 Pike County cultural map shows a Fire Tower off of old I-64 southwest of Augusta

evidence.supports: Crews is an interpretive naturalist at Lincoln State Park
evidence.quote: Michael Crews is an Interpretive Naturalist at Lincoln State Park

evidence.supports: Lincoln, Ferdinand and Hartwell towers worked together to triangulate fires
evidence.quote: Those three worked in unison to triangulate fires,

evidence.supports: administered by Indiana Division of Forestry
evidence.quote: Administered by Indiana Division of Forestry

evidence.supports: June 2022 map legend marks the tower closed
evidence.quote: Pike State Forest map from June 2022; note that legend indicates that the Fire Tower is closed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Indiana Fire Towers gives 1935 as the completion year on its history page and a 1935 to 1952 window on its Hartwell page. Its structural survey note says constructed before 1952, and the 1946 NGS description already places a tower at the site.

sources.title: Indiana and its long history with fire towers, 13 left standing

notes_for_editor: Build date disputed (1935 completion vs a 1935 to 1952 window). Access 'closed' rests on a June 2022 map legend read by Indiana Fire Towers; no current access source found. A Forest Lookouts page also quotes a December 31, 1938 Vincennes Sun Commercial item about a tower 'being re-erected near Stendal' in Pike County State Forest; the item does not name Hartwell, so it is not used. Living New Deal returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Grokipedia was not used.
